verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs describe alerts on logged metrics such as Cost, Correctness and Context Adherence, configured with an aggregation, a threshold and a time window. That covers cost spikes and eval-score drops, but nothing in the pack documents how or where notifications are delivered. missing for 10: documented Slack, PagerDuty or email delivery, explicit error-rate alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email

citations.quote: Each alert configuration includes: a metric e.g. Cost, Correctness, Context Adherence; an aggregation function...; a threshold e.g. < 0.5; a time window e.g. 1 hour
Your cost is higher than expected, Your model is hallucinating more than you want
Galileo enables you to get alerted whenever unexpected things happen.
